1.

Thy supper, Lord, so good, Speaks of Thee, Thou gavest Thy body, Thy blood, Established peace. A Man of sorrows Thou wast, When here Thy cross Thou didst bear; Glory now Thou hast For everlasting time.

2.

Thanks for Thy word of grace, Light on our path! Thanks for Thy rich table, Spread by Thee! With this wine and bread We now commemorate Thy death; As Thou Thyself didst bid us, We remember Thee.
